A. Overview. Etsy charges a fee (the “Payment Processing Fee”) for each transaction processed through Etsy Payments. The fee amount will be assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax (if applicable). Payment Processing Fees will be reflected in your payment account and will be deducted from the total amount of the payment at the time the payment is considered complete.
B. Fee Amount. Payment Processing Fees vary based on the location of a seller’s bank account.

In the event of any partial or full refunds credited back to a buyer by a seller, the Payment Processing Fee and other applicable fees will be recalculated based on the adjusted sale price. The difference between the original Payment Processing Fee and the adjusted Payment Processing Fee will be applied to the refund amount being credited back to the seller.

Payment processing fees are a set rate plus a percent of the total sale price of the item. This rate and percent vary by country. The fees are taken from the item’s total sale price, including its shipping fees, and any applicable sales tax.
These processing fees appear in your payment account and are deducted prior to deposit.
Payment processing fees are in addition to the 6.5% transaction fee that applies to the cost of the entire order.
The payment processing fee is assessed on the total amount of the sale, including tax and shipping. Payment processing fees are deducted from the sale amount in your payment account.
The standard Etsy Payments Payment Processing Fee (described below) applies to orders that go through integrated PayPal; there is no additional PayPal fee.
Etsy also charges the Etsy Payments payment processing fee described above on Etsy Gift Card, Etsy Credit, and Etsy Coupon transactions.
You will be charged a listing fee of $0.20 USD for each item that you list for sale on Etsy.com or Etsy's mobile apps.

You will be charged a listing fee whether or not the listed item sells, unless you create a private listing, in which case you will only be charged the listing fee when the private listing is sold. Etsy.com listings expire after four months.
If you list multiple quantities of the same item, the initial listing fee will be $0.20, and the listing will be automatically renewed at $0.20 after each of the items sells.
When you make a sale through Etsy.com, you will be charged a transaction fee of 6.5% of the price you display for each listing plus the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping.
If you sell from the US, the transaction fee will not apply to sales tax.
Etsy charges 6.5% of the total order amount in your designated listing currency.

As an Etsy Payments user, if you decide to list in a currency other than that of your payment account, you will be charged a 2.5% currency conversion fee on the sale amount to send funds to your payment account.

C. Listing Currency Conversion Considerations for Sellers. When a seller lists and subsequently sells an item in a currency other than the currency of the seller's payment account, Etsy will settle the associated transaction proceeds in the currency of the seller's payment account. When such a service is required, Etsy applies an additional 2.5% currency conversion fee.

E. Instant Transfer (US seller only). Eligible U.S sellers may use instant transfer to make transfers from their Etsy Payment account directly to their bank account, subject to a fee. Please note that if applicable, an instant transfer fee will be charged and displayed as part of the transfer process.

notes: US processing fee 3% + $0.25 USD is stated identically on the Etsy Payments Policy (Section 9B table, 'Last updated on Jul 31, 2026') and on help article 115015628847. Both label the fixed part as a 'flat fee per order'.

URL note: the task's suggested path etsy.com/legal/policy/etsy-payments-policy was not fetched; the Fees & Payments Policy links to https://www.etsy.com/legal/etsy-payments/ which is the live 'Etsy Payments Policy' page and was used.

Base difference: the processing fee base INCLUDES sales tax and shipping; the 6.5% transaction fee base is display price + shipping + gift wrap and, for US sellers, EXCLUDES sales tax. Listing fee is per listing/renewal, not per sale.

The help article rounds the Etsy Payments policy table slightly differently in places (e.g., 'India | 5%+ 25 INR' vs '5% + 25 INR'; Vietnam '11500 VND' vs '11,550 VND') — non-US, flagged only as evidence the two tables are maintained separately. US row matches exactly.
Etsy Payments policy table shows 'effective July 8, 2024' rate changes for Mexico and Türkiye only; no dated change for the US row.
Etsy.com pages blocked the crawl4ai and plain fetchers; they loaded with the stealth Playwright fetcher. Help-center (Zendesk) pages loaded with a plain Playwright fetch.
No platform-provided worked example of the processing fee or transaction fee exists on the loaded pages; only the multi-quantity listing-fee example.
Etsy Plus includes '15 listing credits, which are visible as $3 in listings credit' (consistent with $0.20 x 15).
structure: Three fees on every US sale: a $0.20 listing fee per unit sold (the listing renews at $0.20 after each sale); a 6.5% transaction fee on the price you display plus shipping and gift wrap (US sales tax is not included in that base); and Etsy Payments processing of 3% of the gross order — including shipping and tax — plus $0.25 per order. If a sale is attributed to an Offsite Ad within 30 days of a click, an Offsite Ads fee of 15% (12% for shops that have reached $10,000 in trailing sales, for which the program is mandatory) applies to the same base as the transaction fee, capped at $100 per order.
summary: Etsy charges $0.20 to list, 6.5% of the price plus shipping when it sells, and 3% + $0.25 to process the payment (on the order including tax). An Offsite Ads sale adds 12% or 15%, capped at $100.
